latHint: Think saying goodbye - not aircraft components.
pivHint: A hangar stores aircraft PARTS - but drop the S, and to PART means to do what when two people go their separate ways?
winText: Going separate ways. PARTS was the pivot - drop the S and to PART means to LEAVE and go your separate ways.
lossText: LEAVE - to part ways, to go. PARTS was the pivot: drop the S and to PART means to say goodbye and LEAVE.
